The '''Lantillian sector''' was a sector that was located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]]. The sector contained the [[Bracca system]] which was home to the [[planet]] [[Bracca]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
